title: DEC-240: harden CI (ignore-scripts installs, persist-credentials, exact Quest version, env: for outputs)
description: DEC-240 CI hardening for lore-cli (plan item 13, operator dec-00icl6f = A 2026-10-26T13:43:57Z; token d240-lore-cli; relayed by the leader). CI only: release LCLI-751 stays held; do NOT pin actions by SHA here (Wednesday grooming question; the existing pins are untouched). DEC-240 verbatim from opum-doc 2026-10-25 14:10Z: "1. Install lore and quest in CI with `npm install -g --ignore-scripts <pkg>@<exact>`. Dependency lifecycle scripts never run on a runner. A shrinkwrap shipped inside the lore and quest packages is a later lore-cli/quest-cli option, not part of this decision. 2. Every actions/checkout step sets `persist-credentials: false` unless that job pushes with the token. A job that does push keeps it and says why in a comment. 3. The Quest version is read only from inside the managed Quest block's markers, and must match `^[0-9]+\.[0-9]+\.[0-9]+$` exactly. Anything else fails the job by name and never reaches npm as a range. 4. A step output used in a shell step reaches it through `env:`, never interpolated as ${{ }} inside run:. Delivery: this is DEC-182 (1) floor work (CI workflows and installs), so Sonnet or above authors it and Opus reviews it before landing. [...] Proof per repository, both ways: an install with a dependency carrying a deliberately failing postinstall still succeeds; a CLAUDE.md with a partial version fails the read by name." Items 1 and 3 apply only where lore-cli CI installs lore or quest; items 2 and 4 apply to every workflow. Where an item does not apply, the task says so with what was measured. Not landed by the worker: when the PR is green, a detached review worktree is created and the leader spawns the Opus reviewer.

acceptanceCriteria.text: Every actions/checkout step in .github/workflows and .github/actions sets persist-credentials: false, except a job that pushes with the token, which keeps it and says why in a comment (DEC-240 item 2); proved by a test or script that fails on a checkout without it and passes on the real tree

No step output or other ${{ }} expression is interpolated inside a run: shell body where the value can come from outside the repository; such values reach the step through env: (DEC-240 item 4); proved by a check that fails on an interpolated one and passes on the real tree

Every CI install of lore or quest from npm uses npm install -g --ignore-scripts <pkg>@<exact> (DEC-240 item 1), or the task records what was measured showing lore-cli CI installs neither from npm; proved both ways, including an install whose dependency carries a deliberately failing postinstall still succeeding

The Quest version is read only from inside the managed Quest block markers and must match ^[0-9]+\.[0-9]+\.[0-9]+$ exactly, failing the job by name otherwise and never reaching npm as a range (DEC-240 item 3), or the task records why it does not apply; proved both ways with a CLAUDE.md carrying a partial version failing the read by name

The existing action SHA pins are unchanged, the commands run and their outcomes are recorded on the task, and the PR is not landed by the worker: a review worktree detached at the green head is handed to the leader for the Opus review

implementationNotes: BUILD 2026-10-26 (branch ci/LCLI-768-dec-240-hardening). SCOPE MEASURED. npm installs in CI: lore/quest ones are setup-quest (2: exact version and the staged rc) and release.yml (2: the tarball sanity install and the previous platform package in the gate probe); NOT lore/quest and so outside item 1: npm install -g npm@^11 (npm itself), npm install -g @anthropic-ai/claude-code@2.1.287 (third party, its postinstall fetches a native binary; left alone), a bare npm install in the docusaurus scaffold smoke, bun install --global backlog.md, and the bun install of quest-cli source in the setup-quest source fallback (bun, not npm; bun skips untrusted dependency scripts by default). publish-release.sh runs npx on the operator host, not a runner. Checkouts: 27 actions/checkout steps (ci 12, release 13, fast-forward guard 1, upstream watch 1), 3 already persist-credentials false; no workflow runs a git push command (test pins it), so no job keeps the token and the exception list is empty. The fast-forward guard does git fetch origin dev after checkout: the repo is public and unauthenticated upload-pack answers HTTP 200 (curl, 2026-10-26), so it needs no stored credential; that workflow only fires on a main push so it cannot be exercised before landing - say so to the reviewer. Expressions inside run bodies: the only ones left are matrix.* values and github.run_id (workflow-defined or runner-assigned, not outputs); the setup-quest inputs.version and inputs.source-ref (9 sites) moved to env.

CHANGES. scripts/read-declared-quest-version.sh (new): reads only between the quest:agent-instructions:begin/end markers, CR stripped, first word after Quest CLI must match ^[0-9]+\.[0-9]+\.[0-9]+$ else ::error file=... naming the offending value and exit 1; the four inline sed readers (ci.yml x3, release.yml x1) now call bash scripts/read-declared-quest-version.sh CLAUDE.md (bash explicitly: the release probe matrix includes Windows). setup-quest: inputs via env VERSION/SOURCE_REF/DECLARED, a second exact-X.Y.Z refusal before any npm call, npm install -g --ignore-scripts for both installs. release.yml: --ignore-scripts on the tarball sanity install and the previous-platform-package install. persist-credentials: false on every checkout. test/ci-hardening.test.ts (new) pins all four rules over the YAML as data; test/ci-workflow.test.ts and test/release-workflow.test.ts pins updated for the new shapes (the setup-quest npm stub now reads the spec as the last argument; the no exit 1 pin now means no abort in the failed-install branch). Actions are NOT re-pinned (Wednesday question).

PROOF, BOTH WAYS (commands and outcomes). (3) bash scripts/read-declared-quest-version.sh CLAUDE.md => Declared Quest version: 0.14.1, version=0.14.1, exit 0; a block saying Quest CLI 0.14 => ::error file=...::the managed Quest block in ... declares Quest CLI 0.14, which is not an exact X.Y.Z ..., exit 1, no version= written; the same for ^0.14.1, 0.14.1-rc.1, 0.14.1.2, latest and 0.14.1. with a trailing period; a version only OUTSIDE the markers, a missing block and a missing file each fail by name; a CRLF file reads the same (bun test test/ci-hardening.test.ts). setup-quest step body driven with VERSION=^0.14.1 and a stub npm: exit 1, ::error::setup-quest: the version input ^0.14.1 is not an exact X.Y.Z, and the stub records no call; with VERSION=0.14.1 the stub is called with exactly: install -g --ignore-scripts @opum-ai/quest@0.14.1. (1) postinstall proof, real npm, offline: a tarball dependency whose postinstall is node -e process.exit(7): with --dangerously-allow-all-scripts and no --ignore-scripts the install FAILS naming postinstall (control); with --ignore-scripts it exits 0. FINDING: npm 12.2.0 (this host) blocks a dependency install script by default (allowScripts), so the flagless control silently passes on npm 12 unless scripts are forced on; the test forces them on so the control is real on npm 10/11/12, and CI node 22 runs older npm where scripts run by default. (2) and (4): the walk found >= 25 checkouts and > 40 run bodies as positive controls; synthetic units with a bare checkout, persist-credentials true, and a step output, input, needs output and event field interpolated into run: are each rejected; the real tree is accepted.

MUTANTS ON THE REAL TREE (each reverted): dropping one persist-credentials => 1 fail; dropping --ignore-scripts in setup-quest => 2 fail; in the release probe => 1 fail; loosening the version regex to ^[0-9]+\.[0-9]+ => 4 fail; reading the whole file instead of the block => 1 fail; reintroducing ${{ inputs.version }} in a run body => 2 fail. GATES: bun run typecheck clean; bun run lore check exit 0; bash scripts/lint-shell.sh clean over the tracked scripts (new script added after); bun test: 5358 pass 4 skip, 1 fail on the first full run (agent-context budget tests, a 6-8s timing flake that does not touch this diff: it passed on rerun on this tree and on the baseline with my changes stashed). The Windows legs of the new tests are the CI run to read: the reader tests are skipped on win32, the npm install test runs through a shell there.

OPUS REQUEST CHANGES at 0ef1ab4 (rv327-lcli685, token d240-lcli-rc), via the leader, with DEC-240 (a3) = A: item 1 covers every install of the lore or quest packages anywhere in CI, helpers included; a project's own dependency install is OUT. Done in the follow-up pass: C - read-declared-quest-version.sh now requires exactly one begin and one end marker line, begin before end, else fails by name (new tests: unclosed block, duplicated block, reversed markers, stray extra end marker). D - the postinstall control writes a sentinel file and exits 7; the control arm asserts the sentinel exists, the --ignore-scripts arm asserts it does not (a name match no longer proves anything). G - ci.yml claude-code install now npm install -g --ignore-scripts (install.cjs is run explicitly right after); the install test now covers @anthropic-ai/claude-code too. E - gh api repos/opum-ai/lore-cli -q .visibility => public (measured 2026-10-26); the stale private repo comment in upstream-backlog-watch.yml is corrected. F (recorded only) - setup-quest's source fallback is dormant in steady state (LCLI-750 removed the pinned ref): it only runs when the declared quest version is neither on npm nor staged and a caller passes source-ref; it uses bun install --frozen-lockfile of quest-cli source, not npm, so item 1 does not reach it, and bun skips dependency lifecycle scripts it has not been told to trust.

BLOCKED, NOT CHANGED - A (item 1): benchmark/ladybug/package-qualification.ts:339 (npm install --global <root.tgz> <platform.tgz>) and :374 (npm install <root.tgz> <platform.tgz>) install lore on all six release hosts without --ignore-scripts. NOT edited, and no exemption recorded, because adding the flag to :339 defeats what that job qualifies. The step is labelled installing both tarballs into an isolated global npm prefix without script approval, and assertNoInstallScriptApproval (line 1277) fails the job when npm's output matches allow-scripts, unapproved install script, blocked.*install script or @ladybugdb/core, i.e. it measures the user install path's behaviour under npm's script policy. MEASURED 2026-10-26 on npm 12.2.0 with a dependency carrying a postinstall: without the flag npm prints the install-scripts blocked warning (4 matching lines); with --ignore-scripts it prints none (0). So with the flag the assertion could never fire: the check goes vacuous, and the qualification would stop catching a future dependency that needs script approval on a user machine. The lore launcher and platform packages themselves carry no lifecycle scripts (package.json scripts has no install, postinstall or prepare), so the flag would change nothing about what is installed today. :374 is the second install, an isolated Node project; it asserts the absence of @ladybugdb/core on disk, which --ignore-scripts does not affect, but it is the same user install path. Escalated to the leader for a ruling; the widening of installViolations to scan benchmark/ and scripts/ sources waits on that ruling, because adding it before the sites are resolved would either go red or require an exemption.

DEC-240 (a4) = A, opum-doc 2026-10-26T14:39:19Z (opum-ai/opum-doc#1394), verbatim: "package-qualification.ts:339 is the ONE ruled exception to item 1, under four conditions: (1) It installs only the locally built lore tarballs, by path, into a scratch prefix, never a registry spec. (2) That step env has no GITHUB_TOKEN, GH_TOKEN, NODE_AUTH_TOKEN or NPM_TOKEN: unset them in the step and assert their absence before the install. (3) assertNoInstallScriptApproval (:1277) stays. It is what makes this safe, since npm 12 blocks and reports unapproved scripts rather than running them. (4) A comment at :339 cites DEC-240 (a4), and the scan lists :339 as the single exception. :374 takes --ignore-scripts. If release hosts ever run an npm that executes unapproved scripts by default, the exception lapses and comes back to me." Scope sites: benchmark/ladybug/package-qualification.ts global install (the exception, now commented) and the project install (now --ignore-scripts). Built: assertNoInstallSecrets/withoutInstallSecrets (exported, tested both ways), and test/ci-hardening.test.ts scans benchmark/ and scripts/ sources with the exception keyed by file+args, count one; mutants (drop --ignore-scripts, drop scrubber) go red.
